newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: ZIMBABWE MONEY MARKET LIQUID, RATES MIXED.
newsitem.headline: ZIMBABWE MONEY MARKET LIQUID, RATES MIXED.

text.p: Short-term trading rates on Zimbabwe's money market were quoted mixed in fairly active trade on Wednesday, dealers said.

The Reserve Bank sold Z$350 million worth of treasury bills at 15.95 percent to mop up excess liquidity and discount houses were selling the central bank paper in the secondary market at 15.75 percent, unchanged from Tuesday.

NCDs with maturity of 30, 60 and 90 days were being bought at 16.75 percent, slightly up from 16.50 and sold at 16.50 from 16.25 percent. Bank bills were at 16.25 and 15.80 percent (buying and selling) from 16.25 and 16 percent while call money eased to 15.50 from 15.75 percent.
Reserve Bank figures showed the market closed Z$30 million in surplus on Tuesday compared with a Z$28 million deficit on Monday.
